rule: Seeing a newer build publishes the resulting notice change.
Applying a GM command publishes the resulting change.
A player delta withdraws record keys that are no longer visible.
A withdrawn pending key is sent again as its replica record.
Only the first part of a split delta carries withdrawn keys.
A repeated projection nonce is answered only once.
Restarting a stream assigns a new engine id.
A record with a changed version is sent even when its key is already held.
